name: Heart of Disruption
label: Quest
description: The Image of Archmage Modera asks you to help contain an arcane disruption in Dalaran. The Violet Citadel’s wards are under strain, and the Kirin Tor…
intro: The Image of Archmage Modera asks you to help contain an arcane disruption in Dalaran. The Violet Citadel’s wards are under strain, and the Kirin Tor need time to bring the crisis under control.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Whatever disturbed the leylines, it started at the top of the Violet Citadel. A thunderous crash rang out from the parlors above, and now we are overrun with rampant arcane power. It's taking all we have just to keep the wards in place.
We cannot afford to stall any longer. We need help.

The Kirin Tor are busy inside, but you will still need a less public approach to gain entry. Take this key and meet me in the citadel once you've made your way into the city. We must put an end to this disruption.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What good is our pride if there isn't a city left standing to be proud of?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I don't know what you saw up there, friend, but it does not matter. What matters now is containing this mote and putting an end to this madness.
You did your part well. Now the rest is up to us.
